description: This file defines a specific assertion class, 'ThingAssert', used for testing and verifying properties of 'Thing' objects within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides numerous assertion methods to verify attributes, features, lifecycle, revision, and other characteristics of 'Thing' instances, primarily for use in unit tests.

classes.name: ThingAssert
classes.description: A specialized assertion class extending AbstractJsonifiableAssert for verifying various properties of Thing objects in tests. It provides a fluent API for asserting attributes such as ID, namespace, ACL, features, lifecycle, revision, timestamps, and metadata.

methods.name: hasId
methods.description: Asserts that the actual Thing has the expected identifier.

methods.name: hasNoId
methods.description: Asserts that the actual Thing does not have an identifier.

methods.name: hasNamespace
methods.description: Asserts that the actual Thing's namespace matches the expected value.

methods.name: hasNoNamespace
methods.description: Asserts that the actual Thing has no namespace.

methods.name: hasPolicyId
methods.description: Asserts that the actual Thing's policy ID matches the expected value.

methods.name: hasNoPolicyId
methods.description: Asserts that the actual Thing has no policy ID.

methods.name: hasAcl
methods.description: Asserts that the actual Thing's Access Control List matches the expected.

methods.name: hasNoAcl
methods.description: Asserts that the actual Thing has no ACL.

methods.name: hasAclEntry
methods.description: Asserts that the actual ACL contains an entry for the given authorization subject with the specified permissions.

methods.name: hasAttribute
methods.description: Asserts that a specific attribute at the given JSON pointer path has the expected value.

methods.name: hasNotAttribute
methods.description: Asserts that the specified attribute at the given path does not exist.

methods.name: hasDefinition
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing's definition matches the expected.

methods.name: hasNoDefinition
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing has no definition.

methods.name: hasFeature
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing has a specific feature.

methods.name: hasFeatureWithId
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing has a feature with the specified ID.

methods.name: hasNotFeatureWithId
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing does not have a feature with the specified ID.

methods.name: hasFeatures
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing's features match the expected features.

methods.name: hasNoFeatures
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing has no features.

methods.name: hasFeatureProperties
methods.description: Asserts that a feature has the expected properties.

methods.name: featureHasNoProperties
methods.description: Asserts that a feature has no properties.

methods.name: hasFeatureProperty
methods.description: Asserts that a feature's property at the given path has the expected value.

methods.name: hasNotFeatureProperty
methods.description: Asserts that a feature does not have a property at the given path.

methods.name: hasLifecycle
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing's lifecycle matches the expected.

methods.name: hasNoLifecycle
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing has no lifecycle.

methods.name: hasRevision
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing's revision matches the expected.

methods.name: hasNoRevision
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing has no revision.

methods.name: hasModified
methods.description: Asserts that the modified timestamp matches the expected.

methods.name: isModified
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing has been modified.

methods.name: hasNoModified
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing has not been modified.

methods.name: isCreated
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing has a created timestamp.

methods.name: hasCreated
methods.description: Asserts that the created timestamp matches the expected.

methods.name: hasNoCreated
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing has no created timestamp.

methods.name: isModifiedAfter
methods.description: Asserts that the modified timestamp is after a given Instant.

methods.name: isNotModifiedAfter
methods.description: Asserts that the modified timestamp is before a given Instant.

methods.name: isEqualToButModified
methods.description: Asserts that the actual Thing is equal to another but with different modified timestamp.

methods.name: hasMetadata
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing's metadata matches the expected.

methods.name: hasEqualJson
methods.description: Compares the JSON representation of the actual and expected Thing objects, optionally using a field selector and predicate.
